_comment: T-335, the HUD's numbers. The run timer's clock (HUD and menus, Decisions, 'The HUD looks like a livestream'): its digits are green above the first switch point, then yellow, orange and red as the time nears 0:00. Proposals from the board's layout page; the board judges them in playtests. above_seconds: the colour holds while the time left is strictly above this; the last step (red) has no limit. layout: game pixels at 1152 x 648 (the board's saved page), anchored to the bottom-left corner.

viewers_counter._comment: T-336, the live viewers counter (HUD and menus, Decisions, 'The HUD looks like a livestream' and 'Tricks bring viewers, shown in one colour'). layout: the board's layout page at 1152 x 648, anchored to the bottom-right corner. color: the viewers colour (T-339's panel rim and eye, #33e1ff), used for nothing else in the HUD. The rest are proposals for the playtest: number_sizes per look step (0 base, 1 to 3 the heat steps; the fire step uses the last), detach_seconds (how long after a trick popup shows its amount leaves it), flight_seconds and flight_arc (the arc's height in pixels), bump_seconds and bump_scale (the pop when an amount lands), flash_seconds, crash_flash_seconds, drop_seconds and drop_px (the '-{viewers}' falling away on a crash), crash_color (the combo broken popup's warning red-orange).

reactions._comment: T-351, the reaction icons (HUD and menus, Decisions, 'The HUD looks like a livestream'). All proposals for the playtest; the board asked for more and more noticeable ones, from the side where the viewers counter is (quick tuning, 2026-10-28). cap: most icons on screen at once. alpha: their opacity. icon_scale: screen pixels per art pixel. rates_per_second: groups of floaters per second for each look step of the live viewers counter (0 base, 1 to 3 the heat steps, 4 fire at 1,000,000); 0 means none. Each group is group_min to group_max icons, and the gap to the next is the mean (1 / rate) times a random share between gap_min_share and gap_max_share, so the gaps are uneven. Floaters start below the bottom edge at a random x between lane_from and lane_to of the screen width (about the viewers counter's width, 0.76 to 0.99 of it, so the right side only), rise at rise_min to rise_max pixels per second up to near the top, swaying wobble_px at wobble_hz, popping from pop_from to full size over pop_seconds, fading in over fade_in and out from fade_out_from of their life. The burst: burst_count icons out of the sub goal square at burst_speed_min to burst_speed_max pixels per second, slowed by burst_drag, drifting up at burst_rise, lasting burst_seconds_min to burst_seconds_max.

sub_goal._comment: T-337, the sub goal square (HUD and menus, Decisions, 'The HUD looks like a livestream'): game pixels at 1152 x 648 from the board's layout page, the 128 x 128 square with its label under it; anchored to the right edge, at the same share of the height.
